nvitk.measure.suv
=================

.. py:module:: nvitk.measure.suv

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Standardized Uptake Value (SUV) utilities for PET.

   Port of [BioImaging _pet.py](/home/imarcoss/BioImaging/src/imaging/measure/_pet.py)
   with the following fixes:

   - Drops the stray ``from curses import raw`` import.
   - Makes the Philips SUV scale factor path consistent between :func:`suv_image`
     and :func:`suv_stats` (the legacy ``compute_pet_metrics`` hard-coded
     ``philips_factor = None``).
   - Uses :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` as the public input type.

   Backend policy
   --------------
   Arithmetic on voxel data (``activity * factor``, per-slice rescaling,
   statistics) stays on the active backend. ``to_numpy`` is only invoked when
   emitting Python floats at the final stat step.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.measure.suv.suv_image
   nvitk.measure.suv.suv_stats


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: suv_image(pet: nvitk.types.Image | Any, metadata: Dict[str, Any] | None = None, *, kind: str = 'bw', philips: bool = False, revert_scaling: bool = False) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Convert a raw PET image to an SUV image.

   :param pet: PET image. If an :class:`Image`, *metadata* defaults to ``pet.metadata``.
   :param metadata: DICOM-style metadata. Required if *pet* is a bare array.
   :param kind: ``bw``, ``lbm``, ``bsa``, or ``ibw`` (also accepts legacy ``SUVbw``...).
   :param philips: If True (default) and the Philips ``(7053,1000)`` SUV factor is present,
                   use that as a direct multiplier. Set to False to always compute from
                   half-life/weight.
   :param revert_scaling: If True, undo scanner-applied ``RescaleSlope/Intercept`` per slice before
                          applying the SUV factor.

   :returns: SUV image. Matches the input type (``Image`` in -> ``Image`` out).
   :rtype: Image | ndarray


.. py:function:: suv_stats(pet: nvitk.types.Image | Any, mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, metadata: Dict[str, Any] | None = None, *, kinds: Iterable[str] = ('bw', ), stats: Iterable[str] = ('mean', 'median', 'max', 'min', 'std', 'p95', 'p5', 'p99'), philips: bool = False, revert_scaling: bool = False) -> Dict[str, float]

   Compute SUV statistics restricted to ``mask > 0``.

   :param pet: PET image (raw scanner counts unless *revert_scaling* is used).
   :param mask: Mask image/array with same shape as *pet*.
   :param metadata: DICOM-style metadata. Defaults to ``pet.metadata`` when available.
   :param kinds: Iterable of SUV kinds (``bw``/``lbm``/``bsa``/``ibw``).
   :param stats: Per-kind stats to compute (same names as :func:`nvitk.measure.masked_stats`).
   :param philips: Enable the Philips ``(7053,1000)`` short-circuit for SUVbw.
   :param revert_scaling: If True, undo per-slice rescaling before applying the SUV factor.

   :returns: ``{'SUVbw_mean': ..., 'SUVbw_max': ..., 'SUVlbm_mean': ...}``.
   :rtype: dict[str, float]
